data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The distinction between 'decentralized' and 'monolithic' is a red herring; resilience is determined solely by the 'Diversity Index' of the execution substrate.","counterconditions":[{"case":"Administrative diversity provides a non-technical hedge (e.g., different operators react differently to the same external stimulus, preventing simultaneous manual errors).","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"High diversity increases the 'Long Tail' of unique bugs, increasing the frequency of isolated failures even if correlated failures decrease.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Resilience to correlated failure is a function of the variance in the failure-triggering surface.
